name: quick-replies
description: Claude Code's own next-message suggestion as a button above Clawd; click it, type 1 in the empty prompt, or send just 1 to send it. With /replies more on, up to three more suggestions from a fork of the session.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

more.title: More suggestions via fork
more.description: Besides Claude Code's own suggestion, ask a fork of the session for up to three more after every answer. Costs roughly one short answer per answer, mostly from the cache. /replies more on|off overrides this for all sessions.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: 2 × 2 if the labels fit, otherwise one per row. grid: always 2 × 2. list: always one per row.
